result.summary: Found 2 issues: one major layout truncation issue and one minor visual inconsistency.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section is cut off — the restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated and the card image is partially clipped at the right edge, suggesting a horizontal overflow or carousel layout issue where the last visible item is not fully rendered.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the carousel or horizontal scroll container properly shows partial cards as a visual affordance for scrollability, or adjust padding/margin so the truncation looks intentional and the text label is not awkwardly cut mid-word.

issues.description: The bottom pizza restaurant card is cut off vertically at the bottom of the screen without any visual indicator that it continues, which may confuse users into thinking the page content ends there.
issues.suggestion: This is likely intentional to hint at more scrollable content, but adding a subtle gradient fade at the bottom could improve the visual affordance for scrollability.
